name: Tracker Header 5
definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual transactions included in the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the tracker informing party and sent by the tracker to unambiguously identify the message.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

NumberOfTransactions.name: Number Of Transactions
NumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions contained in the message.

TrackerInformingParty.name: Tracker Informing Party
TrackerInformingParty.definition: Party that provides information on the status and related details of a transaction.

TrackerInformedParty.name: Tracker Informed Party
TrackerInformedParty.definition: Party that is updated on the status and related details of a transaction.

OriginalTrackerUpdate.name: Original Tracker Update
OriginalTrackerUpdate.definition: Original reference, as assigned by the informer and sent to the tracker to unambiguously identify the tracker update message.||Usage: this element may only be present when the alert notification is related to a payment status tracker update.

ServiceLevel.name: Service Level
ServiceLevel.definition: Agreement under which or rules under which the tracker update should be processed.
